goal: GENERALITY + single-mesh: 6 cubes onto a REAL referenced PALLET (pallet.usd, single-mesh, collision baked) via drop_fixture. Proves the auto-distribute works on a DIFFERENT fixture type + the single-mesh overall-bbox-top fallback.
thoughts:
Six two-tier shelf specifics for CP-36 (extends CP-08 — drop_targets with distinct z-levels):
1) 2-level shelf: bottom tier at z=0.825, top tier at z=1.0 (~17cm separation).
2) drop_targets: Cube_1 + Cube_2 to bottom tier, Cube_3 + Cube_4 to top tier. Each tier has 2 slots side-by-side.
3) Top tier z=1.0 → robot reach: 1.0-0.75=0.25m vertical from base. Within Franka's 0.85m reach at moderate xy.
4) Tier separation 17cm > 5cm cube + 5cm clearance → cubes on bottom don't collide with EE during top placement.
5) Bottom tier slots: (-0.05, -0.4, 0.825), (+0.05, -0.4, 0.825). Top tier slots: (-0.05, -0.4, 1.000), (+0.05, -0.4, 1.000).
6) Pallet column at [0, -0.4, 0.475] (0.95m tall) provides physical structure for both tiers.
code:
# Toolified opening: light+ground+cell+table+physics in ONE call
create_scene_baseline(table_size=[2.0, 1.0])

robot_wizard(
    robot_name="franka_panda",
    dest_path="/World/Franka",
    position=[0, 0, 0.75],
    orientation=[0.7071068, 0, 0, 0.7071068],
)

create_conveyor(
    prim_path="/World/ConveyorBelt",
    position=[0.0, 0.4, 0.78],
    size=[3.0, 0.4, 0.05],
    surface_velocity=[0.2, 0, 0],
)

for i, x in enumerate([-1.4, -1.15, -0.9, -0.65, -0.4, -0.15]):
    path = f"/World/Cube_{i+1}"
    create_prim(prim_path=path, prim_type="Cube", position=[x, 0.4, 0.835], size=0.05)
    for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
        apply_api_schema(prim_path=path, schema_name=api)

bulk_set_attribute(
    prim_paths=[f"/World/Cube_{i+1}" for i in range(6)],
    attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold",
    value=0.0,
)
for path in [f"/World/Cube_{i+1}" for i in range(6)]:
    apply_physics_material(prim_path=path, material_name="rubber")

# REAL shelf fixture: a referenced warehouse rack (SM_RackShelf_01) instead of procedural floating
# slabs. Collision is PRE-BAKED in the asset (all 3 sections have PhysicsCollisionAPI) so cubes rest
# on the REAL deck. Geometry came from measure_fixture.py (NOT hardcoded): native 4.0x1.08x0.37m,
# top deck (Section1) footprint 3.81x0.92m at local z=0. Scaled 0.2 -> 0.76x0.18m deck; positioned so
# the measured deck sits at world z=0.825 (Franka-reachable, matches the original bottom-tier height).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/RealPallet", prim_type="Xform", position=[0, -0.4, 0.825], scale=[0.55, 0.55, 0.55])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/RealPallet", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Props/Pallet/pallet.usd")

add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[0.4, 0.4, 0.835], size=[0.06, 0.06, 0.06])

# drop_targets — 4 cubes spread on the MEASURED real deck (deck top world z=0.825 -> cube center 0.85)
setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path="/World/ConveyorBelt",
    source_paths=[f"/World/Cube_{i+1}" for i in range(6)],
    destination_path="/World/RealPallet",
    drop_fixture="/World/RealPallet",  # AUTO: controller measures the real deck at execution -> drop targets
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Table", "/World/ConveyorBelt", "/World/RealPallet"],
)
extension_notes: CP-36 demonstrates vertical workspace utilization with distinct z-tiers. drop_targets dispatches cubes to different z-heights based on cube identity. Robot must clear top shelf during transit (planning_obstacles include ShelfTop).
failure_modes: Top tier z=1.0 — robot must reach 0.25m above base. Within Franka's vertical reach.
EE_INITIAL_HEIGHT auto = max(source_z, max_drop_z) + 0.20 = 1.0 + 0.20 = 1.20m. EE clears top shelf during transit.
Cube placement on TOP shelf at z=1.0: robot descends from h1=1.20 to z=1.0. 0.20m descent — adequate.
verified_status: GENUINE 6/6 DELIVERY, mildly plan-fragile (cont.319-REALSHELF-PALLET 2026-06-21, scene_eyes dur=220): 6 cubes auto-distributed onto a REAL referenced PALLET (pallet.usd, SINGLE-MESH, collision baked) via drop_fixture - all settled z=0.928 on the measured pallet top, 1 z-level flat, ALL UPRIGHT (4.8-9.0deg), 0 never-gripped, min-pair 6.5cm. plan_fails=3 (the scaled pallet geometry triggers a few cuRobo retries; all recovered + delivered -> CP-30-class plan-fragile, NOT a pristine 0-fail GOLD). PROVES: (1) drop_fixture generalises to a DIFFERENT fixture type (pallet vs rack); (2) the SINGLE-MESH overall-bbox-top fallback works (pallet has no sub-surface -> without the fallback drop would fail; 6/6 on the measured top proves it fired).
